info.title: RepoAtlas API
info.description: Code maps of public GitHub repositories: build a snapshot, follow its progress, and read its graph and code. Every error has the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}` with a stable `code`.

post.description:
Check the URL and the repository on GitHub (public, under the size cap), pin the
default branch's head, and reuse the snapshot of that commit built with this pipeline's
configuration: ready, or with its build already queued or running. Otherwise a build is
queued. Follow the job (or the snapshot) until the snapshot is ready.

get.description:
Status (``queued``, ``running``, ``succeeded``, ``failed``), current stage, progress
from 0 to 1, attempts, and why the last attempt failed.

The repository, commit, configuration fingerprint, status, build stats, error, and
latest build job of a snapshot, whatever its status.

The children of ``parent`` at ``level`` and the edges between them, aggregated per
(source child, destination child, kind) with counts and confidence ranges.

get.summary: The edges behind an aggregated edge
get.description:
Edges of ``kind`` from ``from`` (or a node below it) to ``to`` (or a node below it): the
individual imports, calls, and links an aggregated edge in ``/subgraph`` counts, strongest
first, with their call sites and both end nodes. ``total`` counts them all.

Public symbols and routes (outside test files), the files and symbols most used from other
files (imports and calls; name-matched guesses left out), node counts by kind, and how
many source files have linked tests.
A node, the owners of its file, and its edge counts by kind.

post.description: Answer a question about the snapshot with cited code, streaming each step.

200.description: Server-sent events: `status` (`{step}`), `answer` (an `AnswerView`), `done` (`{run_id, trace_id}`), or `error` (the error model).

get.description: A stored answer with its citations and metrics.
A trace with its spans: steps, models, tokens, cost, and time.

post.description:
Tests, public APIs, and callers a change to a symbol (or the code a diff touches) may
break, ranked by score, with paths, evidence, and the sites the graph could not resolve.

get.description: The process is up. Checks nothing else, so it stays cheap for frequent probes.
The database answers and is migrated to the revision this code expects (503 otherwise).

AggregatedEdge.title: AggregatedEdge
AggregatedEdge.description: Edges of one kind between two children: how many, and their confidence range.

AnswerMetrics.title: AnswerMetrics
AnswerMetrics.description:
Measured before invalid citations are removed (decision 0011). Rates are ``None`` when
there was nothing to measure (no claims, no citations).

AnswerView.title: AnswerView
AnswerView.description:
A validated answer: only claims with a valid citation, each citation an evidence
reference. ``metrics`` were measured before invalid citations were removed.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: The build job: queued or running, or for a ready snapshot the job that built it (null when it was built outside the queue, with `repoatlas build`).

reused.title: Reused
reused.description: True when no new build started: the snapshot was ready, or its build was already queued or running.

BuildAccepted.title: BuildAccepted
BuildAccepted.description: A build request's answer. Follow ``job_id`` (or the snapshot) until ``ready``.

Claim.title: Claim
Claim.description:
One statement in the answer, citing the evidence that supports it. ``symbol`` names the
identifier the claim is about, when there is one (it must appear in a cited range).

CodeSlice.title: CodeSlice
CodeSlice.description:
Lines ``start`` to ``end`` (1-based, inclusive, after clamping) of a file's stored text,
joined by ``\n``; ``line_count`` is the number of lines in the whole file.

Degree.title: Degree
Degree.description: Edges at a node by kind (only kinds with at least one edge).

DiffTarget.title: DiffTarget
DiffTarget.description:
A unified diff. ``side="old"``: the snapshot is the code the diff applies to (the
default); ``"new"``: the snapshot already contains the change.

Edge.title: Edge
Edge.description:
A directed edge. ``site`` lies in the source node's file, except for ``tested_by``
edges, whose evidence (an import or a call) lies in the test (destination) file.

EdgeLinks.title: EdgeLinks
EdgeLinks.description:
The edges behind one aggregated edge: edges of ``kind`` from ``src`` or below it to
``dst`` or below it, strongest first; ``total`` counts all of them.

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description: Every ``error.code`` the API returns. Codes are stable: clients may branch on them.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: The body of every error response.

GraphPath.title: GraphPath
GraphPath.description:
``edges[i]`` links ``nodes[i]`` and ``nodes[i + 1]``. ``directed`` is false when no path
follows the edge directions; then some edges point backwards along the path.

ImpactParams.title: ImpactParams
ImpactParams.description: Search settings. Defaults are the values chosen on the dev split (decision 0019).

side.title: Side
side.description: For a diff: `old` when the snapshot is the code the diff applies to, `new` when it already contains the change.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: The stage the current (or last) attempt reached.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Share of the build done, 0 to 1.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the last attempt failed, if it did.

run_after.title: Run After
run_after.description: When a queued job becomes due (retries wait).

JobView.title: JobView
JobView.description: A background job and how far it has got.

Neighborhood.title: Neighborhood
Neighborhood.description:
Nodes within ``depth`` hops of ``root`` (the root excluded), by depth then key, and the
edges the search followed, in canonical order. ``truncated``: the node cap was hit.

Node.title: Node
Node.description: A directory, file, symbol, or route. ``dir`` and ``file`` nodes have no ranges.

NodeDetail.title: NodeDetail
NodeDetail.description: A node, the owners of its file (most commits first), and its edge counts.

Overview.title: Overview
Overview.description:
Where to start reading a snapshot.

``public_symbols``: public classes and functions, most used from other files first ·
``routes``: routes outside
test files · ``core_files`` / ``core_symbols``: the most
used from other files (imports and calls, guesses left out) · ``tested_files``: source files
with at least one ``tested_by`` edge, out of ``source_files`` (test files excluded).

Owner.title: Owner
Owner.description: One author's share of a file's commits. The email is only ever stored hashed.

PathStep.title: PathStep
PathStep.description: One step from a changed symbol towards an affected one (``src`` is nearer the change).

Ranked.title: Ranked
Ranked.description: A node with how often other files use it, and from how many files.

ReadyStatus.title: ReadyStatus
ReadyStatus.description: Readiness: the database is reachable and migrated to the revision this code expects.

SearchResults.title: SearchResults
SearchResults.description:
Exact matches first (key, name, or qualified name, any case), then prefixes, then
trigram matches by similarity.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the build failed, if it did.

job.description: The snapshot's latest build job, if any.

SnapshotView.title: SnapshotView
SnapshotView.description: A snapshot (any status): the repository, commit, configuration, and build stats.

Subgraph.title: Subgraph
Subgraph.description: The children of ``parent`` at ``level`` (key order) and the edges between them.

SymbolMatch.title: SymbolMatch
SymbolMatch.description:
A search hit: ``exact`` (key, name, or qualified name, ignoring case), ``prefix``, or
``fuzzy`` (trigram similarity); ``score`` is the best trigram similarity (0 to 1).

UnknownSite.title: UnknownSite
UnknownSite.description: A place that may depend on the target but that the graph cannot confirm.

Usage.title: Usage
Usage.description: Tokens of one call (or a sum of calls). ``input_tokens`` excludes cached tokens.
